findings.location: ## Example, first paragraph, sentence beginning ‘The rotation weights…’
findings.evidence: The statement assigns mass dimension one to ε₁, ε₂, and m̃ but gives no unit convention or natural-units declaration. Its sole logical dependency, lem-qftx-u1-one-instanton-adhm-space, defines these quantities as equivariant character classes and does not supply a physical unit system. The displayed rational calculation is unaffected, but the physical dimension claim is underspecified.

coverage_note: Reviewed both assigned pages, all five assigned items, the 31-item current-run dependency closure, three prerequisite pages, and the exact statements of direct published quotient, Borel–Moore, Chern, Euler, and Thom suppliers. Source checks used Pestun §1 equations (1.3)–(1.4) and the regulator caveat, §2 equations (2.24)–(2.30), and §5 equations (5.11)–(5.12) ([paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0712.2824)); Nekrasov §3.3 equation (3.9) and §3.6 ([paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/hep-th/0206161)); and Nakajima–Yoshioka §3.1, Theorem 3.2 ([paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0311058)). I did not independently re-audit the full transitive proof trees of published mathematics suppliers or every source-dependent detail in the upstream S4 postulate outside the interfaces consumed by batch 51.
